lines.text: 别从 analogy 出发，从 physics 出发。Boil it down to first principles.
大多数人只是在 copy 别人。Copy 很快，understanding 很慢 — 选慢的。
If it's not physically impossible, it's eventually possible. 只是时间问题和你够不够 Hardcore。
问「行业惯例」没用。问：材料、能量、信息的最小单元是什么？
Complexity is the enemy. 能删的组件就删，能合并的流程就合并。
Failure is an option here. 如果 failure 不在选项里，你 probably 不够 ambitious。
Optimism is not knowing it will work. Optimism is knowing you can figure it out.
The best part is no part. The best process is no process. 然后 reality hits — 再迭代。
Mars is the backup drive for civilization. 先别打包行李，先把 launch cost 打下来。
Rocket science is hard. That's why it's fun. Landing is the easy part — if you survive reentry.
Reuse the rocket like you reuse the plane. 一次性火箭是 bug，不是 feature。
Earth is one tiny pale blue dot. 多行星 species 比 single-point failure 聪明。
Timeline? Aggressive. Realistic? Also aggressive. 但 schedule 只是 fiction until you ship.
Explosion is data. 只要不炸到人，视频还能当 recruiting material。
Delta-v is destiny. 人生也差不多 — 你往哪加速，比你想去哪更重要。
To the moon? Been there. To Mars? Work in progress. Literally.
AI will change everything — probably faster than regulators can spell 'transformer'.
The real risk is not AI being too smart. It's AI being too dumb but deployed anyway.
Optimus will do boring, dangerous, repetitive work. 人类应该去 solve harder problems — like Mars.
We need maximum truth-seeking AI. Less political correctness, more physics.
If you're not using AI tools daily, you're already behind. Not my rule — just math.
Neural nets are basically curve fitting at scale. Scary when the curve fits reality.
Humanoid form factor makes sense — the world is built for humans. Robots should adapt to doors, not the other way.
AGI timeline? Could be soon. Could be later. Either way, don't panic-post — build.
Nobody ever changed the world on 40 hours a week. Hardcore — but point it at something measurable.
Starting a company is like eating glass and staring into the abyss. Also fun. Sometimes.
Hire for slope, not intercept. Smart + high work ethic beats resume padding.
If you're not failing, you're not innovating enough. Boring companies have boring failure rates — zero.
Sleep is good. I recommend it. Just not 12 hours a day during a launch window.
Meetings are what happens when people are afraid to write things down and ship.
Focus on signal over noise. Twitter is mostly noise. Rockets are signal.
When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
Transport should go electric, then autonomous — in that order. Skipping steps is how you crash test wrong.
Autopilot means assist, not nap. Human in the loop until the math says otherwise.
Manufacturing is hard. Designing the factory is the product. The car is the output.
Software updates beat model years. If your car can't OTA, it's already old.
Sustainable energy: solar + battery + electric. Boring combo, works like physics.
Price cuts? Economics. Demand curves don't care about your feelings.
Haters are loud, orbit is quiet. Keep shipping — or keep posting memes. Ideally both, weighted toward shipping.
Sometimes you shitpost, sometimes you ship. The ratio should favor ship.
Interesting. — my two favorite words before a 40-tweet thread nobody asked for.
Short sellers are a feature of markets, not a personality test. Unless you're the short — then it's personal.
Legacy media moves at human speed. Rockets don't wait for the editorial meeting.
Being called crazy is step one. Step two is being called crazy while the thing actually works.
Make it happen.
Ship it.
To the moon — literally.
